name: bento-product
title: Bento product
description: A product section in Tiles: a large media tile that cross-fades between variants chosen with pills, plus facts beside it.

props.name: name
props.description: The product's name, shown as the section's `h2`.

props.name: intro
props.description: A short line under the name.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: A small mono label above the name, such as the maker.

props.name: media
props.description: The picture: a node, or a function that gets the chosen variant (so the picture can change with it).

props.name: defaultVariantId
props.description: The variant chosen first when `variantId` is not controlled. Default the first.

props.name: variantId
props.description: The chosen variant, when you control it.

props.name: onVariantChange
props.description: Called when the visitor picks another variant.

props.name: variantLabel
props.description: The group's name on the switch and its tile: "Colour".

props.name: priceLabel
props.description: The name of the price tile. Default "Price".

props.name: priceFormat
props.description: How the price is written. Default euros, no decimals.

props.name: priceNote
props.description: Fine print under the price: "Incl. VAT. Ships in 3 to 5 days."
